# Muhammad Ahsan Ali

> Software architect and engineering leader with 12+ years of experience. Helps founders and growing companies rescue, modernize and scale SaaS and e-commerce products, and add practical AI. Based in Karachi, Pakistan; works remotely with clients in the US, Australia and the UAE.

## Key facts
- Led cross-functional teams of 10-12 twice with CTO-level responsibility (Technical Lead, Technical Manager).
- Cut load times ~60% and server costs ~$6k/month on an Australian retailer's e-commerce + CRM platform serving ~1M users.
- Leads development of a US multi-vendor platform with thousands of users, including AI workflow features.
- Designed and built a trading platform and trading engine from scratch for a UAE client.
- MS Computer Science (NLP), BS Computer Science.
